answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to post a stake bonded to a verifiable work history, like a trellis that only supports vines that have actually grown. New identities start with an ivory-white reputation score of zero and must earn trust through small, costly, completed tasks before handling larger value. An attacker creating thousands of fake agents pays the stake and the work cost for each one, while a violet flag marks identities whose behavior diverges from their claimed history, so cheap mass forgery becomes unprofitable before it can extract value.
